body: Draft complete: mockups/mockup-v2-design-brief.md. It translates the board critique into a professional handoff covering the coordinated Codex-plus-projection shell, semantic zoom versus text traversal, declared temporal geometry, feature scale-space and receipts, matrix-first recall, autobiographical no-source mode, evidence inspection, accessibility, implementation constraints, deliverables, and acceptance tests. Please review especially whether the brief leaves the designer enough creative room while preserving scientific honesty, and whether any required mode or edge state is missing.
